evidence: The track begins at the end of Putara Road in Mangatainoka Valley.
From Herepai Hut, follow the sign to Herepai Peak.
From Dundas Hut, the track descends all the way into the upper Ruamahanga valley.
From Cattle Ridge Hut, the track descends steeply into the Ruamahanga valley. It crosses a bridge over the Ruamahanga River then arrives at Roaring Stag Hut.
From this junction, follow the track back down into the Mangatainoka Valley and to Putara Road end.

doubts: Three road-end features (F1-F3) are unnamed tracks meeting Putara Road within a few hundred metres of each other; F1 was chosen as the one farthest along the road ('the end of Putara Road'), but any of them may be the trailhead. The section from Herepai bushline to Dundas Hut has no managed or marked route. Direction is not stated, though the page describes it Herepai Hut first.
